date.description: Trading calendar date of wholesale mandi transactions

district.description: Administrative district hosting the agricultural APMC market

market.description: Registered APMC Mandi, Spices Yard, or Wholesale Terminal Market

commodity.description: Agricultural/plantation commodity name (Arecanut, Black Pepper, Copra, Banana, Rubber, Cardamom)

arrivals_tonnes.description: Daily registered physical arrival volume at the mandi

max_price.description: Maximum transaction price recorded on trading day

modal_price.description: Modal wholesale transaction price (primary forecasting target)

temp_mean.description: Daily mean surface air temperature from NASA POWER / IMD
